title: The Pig War: America vs Britain over a pig

music.prompt: Mock-epic comedic historical documentary music, playful snare march, pizzicato strings, no vocals

post.title: America and Britain almost went to war… over a PIG 🐷
post.description: Ridiculous Wars #2 — In 1859 a farmer shot a pig on San Juan Island, and two superpowers nearly started a war. The only casualty? The pig.

scenes.narration: In 1859, America and Britain almost went to war... over a pig.
scenes.tts: In eighteen fifty-nine, America and Britain almost went to war... over a pig.

icons.ai: a cute pink pig looking guilty with a half-eaten potato in its mouth
icons.name: pig

scenes.narration: It happened on San Juan Island, right between Canada and the United States.
A treaty said the border ran through the middle of the channel. But there were two channels... and both countries claimed the islands.

icons.ai: a confused cartoon diplomat scratching his head holding an old map
icons.name: thinking face

scenes.narration: Then one morning, an American farmer named Lyman Cutlar found a pig eating his potatoes. So he shot it.

icons.ai: an angry 1850s American farmer in suspenders and a straw hat pointing at his ruined potato patch
icons.name: man farmer

icons.ai: a happy pink pig digging up and munching potatoes in a garden
icons.name: pig

scenes.narration: The pig belonged to the British Hudson's Bay Company.

icons.ai: a shocked 1850s British fur trader in a top hat and tailcoat, jaw dropped
icons.name: top hat

scenes.narration: Cutlar offered ten dollars for the pig. The British wanted a hundred.

icons.ai: a small stack of old 1850s dollar coins next to a much bigger stack
icons.name: money with wings

scenes.narration: But this is where it gets ridiculous.

icons.ai: a pink pig raising one eyebrow with a smug grin
icons.name: pig face

scenes.narration: The Americans sent soldiers. The British sent warships, one of them with 84 cannons.
scenes.tts: The Americans sent soldiers. The British sent warships, one of them with eighty-four cannons.

card.ai: comedic standoff on a grassy island shore: a small group of 1850s American soldiers in blue uniforms on the beach, a huge old British wooden warship with many cannons in the bay, a confused pink pig standing in the middle, bright sunny day

scenes.narration: Luckily, the British admiral refused to start a war between two great nations over a squabble about a pig.

icons.ai: a Victorian British navy admiral with white sideburns covering his face with one hand in disbelief
icons.name: person facepalming

scenes.narration: So both armies ended up sharing the island... for twelve years.

icons.ai: two 1860s soldiers, one American in a blue uniform and one British in a red coat, happily sharing a picnic on the grass
icons.name: handshake

scenes.narration: In 1872, Germany's Kaiser was asked to settle it, and he gave the islands to the United States.
scenes.tts: In eighteen seventy-two, Germany's Kaiser was asked to settle it, and he gave the islands to the United States.

icons.ai: a stern 19th-century German emperor with a big moustache and spiked helmet banging a judge's gavel
icons.name: crown

scenes.narration: The only casualty of the entire war? The pig. Whose side are you on? Follow for part three.

icons.ai: a cute pink pig with angel wings and a golden halo floating peacefully
icons.name: baby angel
